Descend into a cursed, uncharted jungle where every expedition is a fight against both monstrous creatures and your own unraveling mind. Search for legendary treasures, manage scarce resources, and survive as madness distorts reality with terrifying hallucinations, paranoia, and unexpected dangers. Stealth, teamwork, and knowing when to run may be the only way to make it back alive.

Ready your expedition as The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu launches on July 15th, 2026 on XBOX Series X|S.
